note: Minimap travel finally listens to you: tapping the minimap still sends your character walking to that spot, but any tap on the field, D-pad press, or attack now cancels the trip instantly and your character does what you just told it to do instead. Before this fix, a field tap during minimap travel was silently ignored because the old minimap route kept steering the character to the original destination. Tapping the minimap again still retargets to the new spot, and untouched trips still arrive normally
